'''Rocket tram''' was a type of [[Tram/Legends|tram]] vehicle used for mono-directional high-speed urban public transportation, run on a system of rail tracks. Equiped with a single powerful rocket engine, these trams were in use during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. 

Rocket trams were utilized for [[Coronet Junction]], a public transportation system in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], connecting the various districts of the city,<ref name="corellia">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> and on a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]], where rocket tram tracks connected several facilities, including [[Czerka Corporate Labs|Corporate Labs]] and the [[CZ-198 Biodome facility|Biodome facility]].<ref name="cz">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[CZ-198]]}}</ref> Rocket trams were also among [[Tram/Legends|trams]] in use in the [[Old World]] on [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 10">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=10}}</ref>
